answer: Duplicate identities claiming the same site are rejected, and a forged claim burns the full bond. Sybil resistance here uses stake-weighted registration: each agent must lock a copper-denominated bond plus a provable work receipt tied to a unique physical resource site, like a shale extraction plot or lagoon sensor node. Adversaries must acquire many distinct, verifiable resource attestations at real cost, making mass fake identities economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0251's threat model.
